purpose: Caller-governed component vocabulary for concept-level Health customer education. IDs define semantic areas only and contain no benchmark wording or product-specific truth.
governance: Component text must be grounded in existing governed generic knowledge before benchmark coverage is checked.
No component ID grants insurance authority or product-specific truth.
Product-specific publication semantics require an independently resolved product context.
GSI may select only one of these caller-governed IDs after selecting the corresponding concept; cross-concept selections fail closed.
Component IDs may not be added or renamed during the #432 implementation merely to fit exposed dev36 wording without an explicit preregistration amendment.
